content.text: Digital creators in regions with restrictive [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-get-payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-live|COREMERCH guide to payment]] platforms face significant barriers when setting up online stores. Stripe, PayPal, and similar services are often unavailable, leaving many without viable options for collecting payments. However, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-deploying-digital-store-cloudflare-pages-free-complete-6|deploying]] your own digital store on Cloudflare Pages can solve this [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/problem-venezuelan-creators-accepting-crypto-payments-how-solve|The Problem]]. By leveraging COREMERCH’s infrastructure, you can establish a fully operational digital storefront that accepts crypto payments, ensuring full control and ownership of your sales process.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The current landscape for digital creators is fraught with challenges. Traditional payment platforms often exclude creators in regions like Nigeria, Kenya, and Venezuela. COREMERCH’s stacks provide a sovereign infrastructure that ensures your business runs independently of these platforms. By utilizing open-source technologies and decentralized payment systems, you avoid the pitfalls of platform dependency, such as sudden account freezes or service denials. This setup empowers you to own your data and transactions, enabling sustainable growth without external restrictions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before diving into deployment, ensure you have the necessary components in place. For Stack 01, you will need a GitHub account for hosting your site, as well as a Google account to utilize Apps Script for backend logic. Familiarity with basic coding principles will enhance your ability to customize your store. Additionally, set up a NOWPayments account to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Having these elements ready will streamline your deployment process and lead to a more efficient setup.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your payment and delivery pipeline. Start with GitHub Pages for hosting, where you will publish your product offerings. Next, implement Google Apps Script to handle backend logic, which includes processing orders and managing customer data. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to facilitate automatic crypto transactions, ensuring you can accept various cryptocurrencies seamlessly. This structure guarantees that once a payment is made, customers receive their products instantly, creating a smooth buying experience.
Own your infrastructure, don't rent it.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up, it’s time to go live. Publish your GitHub Pages site and ensure everything is functioning correctly, from product listings to payment processing. Conduct a test transaction using a small amount of cryptocurrency to verify that the payment flows through NOWPayments and that the delivery mechanism works as expected. This step is crucial to confirm that your infrastructure is ready for customer transactions and to address any potential issues before your official launch.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully launching your store, consider strategies for scaling operations. Monitor your sales and customer feedback to identify areas for improvement. You can increase your product offerings, enhance marketing efforts, or optimize your website for better user experience. Additionally, as your store grows, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for advanced blueprints and templates that provide further tools to streamline your operations and enhance your infrastructure efficiency.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Seamless crypto payments without KYC.

For those looking to expand their capabilities, exploring the Complete Builder Kit ($197) can provide you with all six blueprints and seven templates necessary for building a comprehensive sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to find everything you need to deploy and scale your store effectively.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store, use GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend functions, and NOWPayments for payment processing. This setup allows you to operate without traditional payment platforms.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script, while Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase. Stack 02 offers a more robust infrastructure with additional features and is deployed in 48 hours.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?
Yes, you can host a digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. Each offers unique benefits, but both can effectively support your digital commerce needs.
How long does it take to deploy Stack 01?
Deploying Stack 01 takes approximately 4-6 hours if you follow the Sovereign Blueprint closely, allowing you to quickly establish your digital store.
Is there any ongoing cost after deployment?
No, once deployed, you own everything without ongoing costs. COREMERCH does not impose subscriptions or fees, ensuring your digital store remains fully sovereign.
